title: Chapter 401: Black Dragon King Falls Into A Trap
content:
Chapter 401: Black Dragon King Falls Into A Trap

So the Black Dragon King took action as expected.

He flew towards Wang Shuo, spitting out a breath of death from his mouth, and swung his front paws towards Wang Shuo's waist, trying to split him in half.

"Hey, Black Dragon King, you don't have martial ethics!"

Wang Shuo immediately shouted loudly and raised his gun to block.

The huge force directly knocked Wang Shuo back several steps.

Now the Black Dragon King was sure that Wang Shuo's strength definitely did not surpass him and reach the level of a senior warrior.

With his peak mid-level warrior strength, he is enough to crush him. This battle is guaranteed!

As a result, the Black Dragon King no longer held back and attacked with all his strength.

Wang Shuo was also aroused.

Fight with the Black Dragon King.

Wang Shuo moved around, dodging the Black Dragon King's attacks. From time to time, he would thrust out a spear, seize the opportunity, and unleash a big move.

Although the situation was full of dangers, the fight was still successful.

At the same time, the undead army also launched another attack on humans.

With Zhu Dongheng's help, humanity's high-end combat power took advantage, and the undead army was unable to break through the defense line for a while.

Wang Shuo had no supply of water of life at this time, so he fought very carefully to avoid injury and focused on defense and dodge.

The Black Dragon King is unyielding and uses fierce and deadly moves.

The battle was extremely dangerous, and there was still a gap in strength between Wang Shuo and the Black Dragon King.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo was swept away by the Black Dragon King and knocked to the ground.

At this time, Wang Shuo vaguely heard Zhao Bond's voice.

"Bring the Black Dragon King here."

Wang Shuo was confused, but he still did as he was told.

Wang Shuo fought and retreated, retreating towards the back.

Soon we arrived at the location instructed by Zhao Bond.

At this time, the Black Dragon King was completely unaware that he was about to enter the trap set by Zhao Bondang.

Suddenly, a huge formation rose from the ground.

Covering the Black Dragon King and Wang Shuo, Zhao Bangdang also stood up, looking seriously injured.

"Haha... Black Dragon King, you fell into the trap."

The Black Dragon King was horrified and immediately rushed left and right in the formation, hoping to break through the formation.

But this formation is composed of several golden lights, forming a solid cage.

Not far away, hundreds of priests were arranged in a certain formation, sitting on the ground, muttering in their mouths, and chanting spells from their mouths.

"Undead Purification Formation."

The Black Dragon King had a look of fear in his eyes, this formation could purify him.

He could no longer maintain his composure at this point.

Several rays of golden light rushed into his body, erasing the death energy from his body.

Several of his commanders wanted to come to rescue them, but as soon as they touched the edge of the formation, the death energy on their bodies was purified, leaving them completely helpless.

The Black Dragon King lowered his body and began to beg for mercy.

"Zhao Bond, you win, I am willing to join you."

"Black Dragon King, I'm afraid you drank too much fake wine!"

There is something wrong with your brain, so I accept your surrender.

At this time, the human soldiers had an absolute advantage.

Zhao Bangde approached Wang Shuo and patted him on the shoulder.

"Thank you for your hard work. You have made great contributions in this battle!"

Wang Shuo felt a little depressed. He was worried that you would be injured, but he didn't expect you to act like this.

Wang Shuo also knew that if the Black Dragon King could not be trapped in the formation, it would be difficult to eliminate him.

I can only hold my nose and accept the result.

There is nothing wrong with Zhao Bond's move.

At this moment, Wang Shuo had a deeper understanding of Zhao Bond's behavior.

Wang Shuo did not stand here, watching the Black Dragon King being purified.

Instead, he turned around and threw himself into the battlefield.

He has not yet fully mastered his own strength and is lacking a sparring partner.

The few remaining junior warriors on the opposite side are the best opponents.
